auth.title: Member Sign In
auth.subtitle: Access your Roskilde Cricket Club member portal
auth.temporaryPasswordNotice: You are logging in with a temporary password. You must set a new secure password before accessing the club portal.
auth.resetPasswordSubtitle: Please set a new password that meets club security requirements
auth.gdprConsentBody: Roskilde Cricket Club processes your personal data to administer memberships, fixtures, and club communications in accordance with Danish and European data protection laws (GDPR).
auth.gdprConsentCheckbox: I have read and agree to the RCC privacy policy and consent to data processing for club activities.
auth.minorAwaitingConsentBody: Because you are under 18, a linked parent or guardian must sign in and provide GDPR consent before your account can be used.

errors.accountLocked: Account temporarily locked due to multiple failed login attempts. Please try again in 15 minutes.
errors.invitationExpired: Temporary invitation password has expired. Please contact a club administrator for a new invite.
errors.accountDeactivated: This account is inactive. Please contact club administration.
errors.sameAsCurrentPassword: New password must be different from your current temporary password.
errors.genericError: An unexpected error occurred. Please try again.
errors.consentRequired: You must check the box to accept the privacy policy.
errors.tokenExpiredOrInvalid: This password reset link is invalid, expired, or has already been used.

auth.forgotPasswordSubtitle: Enter your email address to receive a secure password reset link
auth.resetLinkSentBody: If an account exists with that email address, we have sent instructions to reset your password. The link will expire in 1 hour.
auth.tokenResetSubtitle: Choose a strong password to regain access to your RCC account
auth.tokenInvalidBody: This password reset link is invalid, expired, or has already been used.
auth.passwordResetSuccessBanner: Your password has been reset successfully. Please sign in with your new password.

dashboard.onboardMemberDesc: Register a new player, coach, parent, or admin and provision credentials.

onboarding.title: Onboard New Member
onboarding.subtitle: Create a club member profile and optionally provision portal login access
onboarding.categoryAdultPlayerDesc: Standalone player/coach/admin with independent credentials. No parent linkage required.
onboarding.categoryYouthPlayerDesc: Under 13 has no login (managed by parents). Ages 13–17 can optionally receive Player login credentials. Linkable to up to 2 parents.
onboarding.categoryUnder13Desc: Under 13 cannot have login credentials. Profile is managed exclusively by linked parents.
onboarding.rolesSubtitle: Adults can hold any combination of roles. Minors (<18) are restricted to Player role only.
onboarding.grantLogin: Grant member access to sign in to the portal
onboarding.grantLoginHelp: Generates a 6-8 character temporary password and dispatches an invitation email. Requires email address and age 13+.
onboarding.parentsSubtitle: Youth and minor players must be linked to at least one parent. Create inline or link an existing member.
onboarding.successParentsNotified: Account invitations dispatched to newly created parents.
onboarding.successEmailSent: An invitation email with temporary credentials was dispatched to {email}.
onboarding.successNoCredentials: Member profile registered without login credentials.

errors.EMAIL_IN_USE: A member with this email address already exists.
errors.PARENT_EMAIL_IN_USE: A parent with this email already exists.
errors.PARENT_1_REQUIRED: Youth/minor players must have at least one linked parent/guardian.
errors.SAME_PARENT_SLOTS: You cannot select the same member for both Parent 1 and Parent 2.
errors.PLAYER_REQUIRES_DOB: Date of birth is required for members assigned the Player role.
errors.DOB_IN_FUTURE: Date of birth cannot be in the future.
errors.MINOR_ROLES_RESTRICTED: Minors under 18 years old can only hold the Player role.
errors.LOGIN_REQUIRES_EMAIL: An email address is required to grant portal login credentials.
errors.LOGIN_REQUIRES_AGE_13: Youth under 13 cannot have portal login credentials.
errors.SAVE_FAILED: Failed to create member. Please verify the information and try again.

validation.invalidEmail: Please enter a valid email address.

invitation.subject: Welcome to Roskilde Cricket Club - Account Activation
invitation.intro: An account has been created for you at Roskilde Cricket Club.
invitation.instructions: Please sign in using your temporary password below within {days} days. You will be prompted to choose a permanent password upon first sign in.
